اشهاببت (form XI)
# اِشْهَابَبْتُ (išhābabtu) /iʃ.haː.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
# اِشْهَابَبْتَ (išhābabta) /iʃ.haː.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
# اِشْهَابَبْتِ (išhābabti) /iʃ.haː.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
